definition: Cultural Heritage agreements cover protection, preservation or promotion of Indigenous cultural heritage.
Economic Development agreements aim to provide economic development opportunities for Indigenous people party to, or affected by, the agreement.
Education agreements cover education for Indigenous people or by Indigenous people.
Employment and Training agreements cover employment and training for Indigenous people.
Environmental Heritage agreements cover protection, preservation or rehabilitation of the natural environment.
Health and Community Services agreements cover provision of health and other community services (housing, childcare, aged care), or activities related to provision of these services.
Intra-Indigenous agreements cover any agreement made between two or more Indigenous parties.
Land Management agreements cover management of land, through establishment of a management plan or committee.
Land Transaction agreements cover a transaction in land, through purchase or consent to grant title (other than Exploration or Mining title).
Mining & Mineral agreements cover grants of mining tenements or conduct of mining activities and mining related activity.
Native Title agreements are agreements made under the Native Title Act 1993 (Cth) or relates to groups recognised under the Act.
Recognition/Acknowledgement agreements give recognition or acknowledgement to Indigenous people or group of an area, but not specific recognition of Native Title or traditional ownership rights.

definition: Agreements recognise Native Title or traditional ownership rights.

pref_label: Recognition of Traditional Rights and Interests
definition: Agreements recognise traditional rights and interests in a formal way.

definition: Reconciliation agreements cover initiatives to address reconciliation between Indigenous and non-indigenous people for past injustices.
Research agreements cover research programs or material.
Sports and Physical Recreation agreements cover sport and physical recreation activities, programs and developments.
Local Government agreements cover activities or policies of local government.
Self-Government agreements cover self-governance for Indigenous peoples, including the jurisdiction of a self-governed area.
Land Settlement agreements provide finalised settlement of land tenure in an area.
Exploration agreements cover grants for mining exploration tenements, or conditions for conducting exploration.
Native Title – Extinguishment agreements cover the extinguishment or surrender of Native Title rights and interests.
Pastoral Activity agreements cover activities undertaken under terms of a pastoral lease or conditions on such activities.

Future Act agreements validate the acts defined in the agreement as either a ‘future act’ or a ‘potential future act’. Does not include agreements that cover activities that may be future acts but are not defined as such in the agreement itself.
Petroleum agreements cover grants of petroleum tenements or conduct of petroleum exploration and production activities.
Aquaculture agreements cover aquaculture activities or practices, or grants for aquaculture purposes.
Defence agreements cover national defence activities.
Horticulture agreements cover horticultural activities or practices, or grants for horticultural purposes.
Agriculture agreements cover agricultural activities or practices, or grants for agricultural purposes.
Compensation agreements provide for the payment of compensation.
Customary law agreements cover the jurisdiction or application of Indigenous customary law.
Consultation agreements include a consultation protocol or process.
Forestry agreements cover forestry activities or practices, or grants for forestry purposes.
Fishing agreements cover fishing activities or practices, or grants for fishing purposes –commercial and amateur.
Intellectual Property agreements cover intellectual property rights, copyright or ownership of an intellectual work.
Implementation agreements cover implementation of another agreement or proposal. Do not select where there is merely a clause in an agreement about the implementation of that agreement.
Land Use agreements cover use and access to land.
Land Planning agreements cover planning rights to land, commonly through the establishment of a management plan or committee.
Law, Policy and Justice agreements cover policies or practices relating to Indigenous people, in the application of state laws and legal system.
Marine agreements cover marine life or areas.

Management/Administrative agreements cover management and administrative schemes or programs either for, or run by, Indigenous people or organisations. Does not include agreements that merely contain a clause for the management or administration of that agreement.
Tourism agreements cover tourism and tourism-related activities and developments.
Water agreements cover use, management and access to water.
Access Agreements cover conditions of, or the process of gaining, access to land.
Leadership agreements aim to develop leadership qualities in members of Indigenous communities.
Oil and Gas agreements cover grants of oil or gas tenements or conduct of oil or gas exploration and production activities.
